# arianet_network (Resource)

A private network. Maps to `/cloud/v1/networks`. The API always creates a first subnet (`subnet_ip_range`, or the whole `ip_range`); add more with `arianet_network_subnet` and routes with `arianet_network_route`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "arianet_network" "private" {
  name            = "private"
  datacenter      = "eu-central-1"
  ip_range        = "10.0.0.0/16"
  subnet_ip_range = "10.0.1.0/24"
  labels          = { env = "prod" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `datacenter` (String) Datacenter code. Changing it replaces the network.
- `ip_range` (String) IP range of the network in CIDR notation (private ranges, e.g. `10.0.0.0/16`). Changing it replaces the network.
- `name` (String) Network name.

### Optional

- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined labels (key/value pairs). Lists can be filtered by them with a label selector.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project the resource is in. Defaults to the account's default project; changing it moves the resource.
- `protection_delete` (Boolean) Whether the resource is protected from deletion. Must be set to false before the resource can be destroyed.
- `subnet_ip_range` (String) IP range of the first subnet, inside `ip_range`. Defaults to the whole `ip_range`. Changing it replaces the network.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Network ID.
- `routes` (Attributes List) Static routes of the network (managed with `arianet_network_route`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--routes))
- `status` (String) Network status.
- `subnets` (Attributes List) Every subnet of the network, including the first one and those of `arianet_network_subnet`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subnets))

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

### Nested Schema for `routes`

Read-Only:

- `destination` (String) Destination range.

### Nested Schema for `subnets`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Subnet status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arianet_network.private 12
```
